Confidence intervals for
improvement in R-squared
are generated using
the `DeltaRSqNB()` function from the `betaNB` package.
In this example,
we use the data set and the model used in
[betaNB: Example Using the BetaNB Function](example-beta-nb.html).


``` r
library(betaNB)
```




``` r
df <- betaNB::nas1982
```

### Regression

Fit the regression model using the `lm()` function.


``` r
object <- lm(QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP, data = df)
```

### Nonparametric Bootstrap


``` r
nb <- NB(object)
```

### Improvement in R-squared

#### Normal-Theory Approach


``` r
out <- DeltaRSqNB(nb, alpha = 0.05)
```

## Methods

### summary

Summary of the results of `DeltaRSqNB()`.

#### Percentile Confidence Intervals


``` r
summary(out, type = "pc")
#> Call:
#> DeltaRSqNB(object = nb, alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Improvement in R-squared
#> type = "pc"
#>            est     se    R   2.5%  97.5%
#> NARTIC  0.1859 0.0595 5000 0.0827 0.3144
#> PCTGRT  0.1177 0.0494 5000 0.0362 0.2269
#> PCTSUPP 0.0569 0.0336 5000 0.0085 0.1376
```

#### Bias Corrected Confidence Intervals


``` r
summary(out, type = "bc")
#> Call:
#> DeltaRSqNB(object = nb, alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Improvement in R-squared
#> type = "bc"
#>            est     se    R   2.5%  97.5%
#> NARTIC  0.1859 0.0595 5000 0.0916 0.3339
#> PCTGRT  0.1177 0.0494 5000 0.0431 0.2439
#> PCTSUPP 0.0569 0.0336 5000 0.0109 0.1436
```

#### Bias Corrected and Accelerated Confidence Intervals


``` r
summary(out, type = "bca")
#> Call:
#> DeltaRSqNB(object = nb, alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Improvement in R-squared
#> type = "bca"
#>            est     se    R   2.5%  97.5%
#> NARTIC  0.1859 0.0595 5000 0.0959 0.3422
#> PCTGRT  0.1177 0.0494 5000 0.0470 0.2612
#> PCTSUPP 0.0569 0.0336 5000 0.0093 0.1411
```

### coef

Return the vector of estimates.


``` r
coef(out)
#>    NARTIC    PCTGRT   PCTSUPP 
#> 0.1858925 0.1176542 0.0568722
```

### vcov

Return the sampling covariance matrix.


``` r
vcov(out)
#>                NARTIC        PCTGRT       PCTSUPP
#> NARTIC   0.0035444269 -0.0002876093 -0.0002412845
#> PCTGRT  -0.0002876093  0.0024358223 -0.0002773651
#> PCTSUPP -0.0002412845 -0.0002773651  0.0011313307
```

### confint

Return confidence intervals.

#### Percentile Confidence Intervals


``` r
confint(out, level = 0.95, type = "pc")
#>               2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC  0.082664555 0.3144045
#> PCTGRT  0.036189159 0.2268987
#> PCTSUPP 0.008547303 0.1375653
```

#### Bias Corrected Confidence Intervals


``` r
confint(out, level = 0.95, type = "bc")
#>              2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC  0.09160237 0.3339368
#> PCTGRT  0.04308459 0.2438804
#> PCTSUPP 0.01089820 0.1436075
```

#### Bias Corrected and Accelerated Confidence Intervals


``` r
confint(out, level = 0.95, type = "bca")
#>               2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC  0.095875198 0.3421785
#> PCTGRT  0.047042641 0.2612361
#> PCTSUPP 0.009337523 0.1411060
```
